title: new_cid: connection ID updates
description: A single 20 KB HTTP/3 GET over a 30 ms RTT path without loss. Right after the handshake, both endpoints issue NEW_CONNECTION_ID frames, switch to a connection ID of the peer and retire the previous one (RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID); quic:connection_id_updated events mark every change. Client and server trace of the same connection.

title: Double vantage point, 100 ms RTT
description: The client and the server trace of one connection in a single file: a 1 MB HTTP/3 download over a 100 ms RTT, 20 Mbit/s path with 1% random loss in both directions. Both traces use the system clock with a real epoch, so they can be aligned in time; packets lost on the path appear in only one of the traces.

title: Congestion control: 6 x 300 KB through a 4 Mbit/s bottleneck with 2% loss
description: Six parallel 300 KB HTTP/3 responses through a 4 Mbit/s bottleneck (50 ms RTT, drop-tail buffer of one bandwidth-delay product) with 2% random loss in both directions. Slow start overshoots the bottleneck buffer, the queue raises the RTT, and the congestion window then alternates between recovery and congestion avoidance. Client and server trace of the same connection.
